mapper.select: SELECT * FROM settings WHERE store_id IN (0, #{storeId}) ORDER BY store_id, setting_key
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO settings (store_id, setting_key, setting_value) VALUES (#{storeId}, #{key}, #{value}) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, store_id, setting_key) DO UPDATE SET setting_value = EXCLUDED.setting_value, updated_at = now()
